name: Coll de Rates
description: Classic Calpe climb over the Coll de Rates. The most well-known climb on the Costa Blanca, used in the Vuelta and a staple of every pro winter training camp.

name: Guadalest Loop
description: Big day from Calpe inland to Guadalest and Castell de Castells. Serious climbing through the mountains of the Marina Alta.

name: Bernia Loop
description: Short but punchy loop from Calpe around the Sierra de Bernia. Every metre of climbing earned.

name: Alcalali Loop
description: Century loop from Calpe through the Jalon valley via Alcalali. Rolling inland roads with 2,000m of climbing.

name: Javea Loop
description: Coastal ride from Calpe to Javea and back. The easiest of the Calpe loops but still has bite.

name: Denia Loop
description: Calpe to Denia along the coast with an inland return. Great mix of coastal flats and interior climbing.
